guard: history reads the newest retained window with --limit, --since, --from and --grep applied to it, adds DMs only with --dms, names each sender at the chat stream's per-sender limit as a gap and each channel's replay policy from the registry, refuses an identity that may not read, names a user's denied channels, shows a person each message's local time, and follows as stream records ending with an end record
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/history-read.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
The user-auth read path is imported from source in process, so that mutation is read without the build.

mutations.name: a window shorter than the retained channel says nothing older is retained
mutations.find: olderRetained = retained === undefined ? null : retained > read.length;
mutations.expectRed: --limit 2 keeps the two newest and says older ones are retained
mutations.cell: --limit 2 keeps the two newest and says older ones are retained

mutations.name: --since a sequence keeps the message at that sequence
mutations.find: if (since?.kind === "seq" && (item.seq === null || item.seq <= since.seq)) return false;
mutations.replace: if (since?.kind === "seq" && (item.seq === null || item.seq < since.seq)) return false;
mutations.expectRed: --since a sequence keeps only later messages
mutations.cell: --since a sequence keeps only later messages

mutations.name: --since a time filters nothing
mutations.expectRed: --since a time keeps only messages after it
mutations.cell: --since a time keeps only messages after it

mutations.name: a window that misses --since claims to reach it
mutations.expectRed: a window that does not reach back to --since says so
mutations.cell: a window that does not reach back to --since says so

mutations.name: --from filters nothing
mutations.find: if (from !== undefined && item.from.name !== from && item.from.id !== from) return false;

mutations.name: --grep matches case-sensitively
mutations.expectRed: --grep matches text case-insensitively within the window
mutations.cell: --grep matches text case-insensitively within the window

mutations.name: --dms reads no DM history
mutations.expectRed: --dms adds DMs, each naming its recipient
mutations.cell: --dms adds DMs, each naming its recipient

mutations.name: a sender at the per-sender limit is not named as a gap
mutations.expectRed: the gap is named: carol is at the per-sender limit on #general, dave is not
mutations.cell: the gap is named: carol is at the per-sender limit on #general, dave is not

mutations.name: the replay policy is not read from the registry
mutations.replace: return { channel: ch, replay: null, window: null };
mutations.expectRed: retention names its per-sender limit, and the channel's replay setting is reported
mutations.cell: retention names its per-sender limit, and the channel's replay setting is reported

mutations.name: a space with no registry bucket fails the replay read
mutations.expectRed: a space with no channel registry has the built-in replay policy, and the read is complete
mutations.cell: a space with no channel registry has the built-in replay policy, and the read is complete

mutations.name: a credential that may not read history gets an unclassified failure
mutations.find: if (denial(e)) throw new CommandFailure("refused", "PERMISSION_DENIED", `this identity may not read ${req.channel ? `#${req.channel}` : "channel history"}
mutations.replace: if (false) throw new CommandFailure("refused", "PERMISSION_DENIED", `this identity may not read ${req.channel ? `#${req.channel}` : "channel history"}
mutations.expectRed: a credential that may not read history is a PERMISSION_DENIED refusal, exit 2, not an empty page
mutations.cell: a credential that may not read history is a PERMISSION_DENIED refusal, exit 2, not an empty page

mutations.name: a user's denied channel is reported as unread, not denied

mutations.cell: a user reads each channel it may, and a denied one is named, not shown empty

mutations.name: a followed message is not written as an event record
mutations.expectRed: a message sent while following is one event record
mutations.cell: a message sent while following is one event record
